cues.text: A room of tall, ornate walls with a large clock face set into them, its hands turning. A long-nosed old man sits in a high-backed armchair at a round table, hands folded under his chin; a young woman stands beside him holding a large book. You sit in a chair across the table from them.
A small sphere forms above the table and fades, leaving a sheet of paper lying on it.
A small light drifts down from above and circles beside you.
